Protocol Description	Cell line	Genomic DNA was extracted with Qiagen Blood and cell culture DNA Mini Kit	Exome capture was performed using the SureSelectXT Mouse Exon Kit	Exome capture libraries were then sequenced by Riken Genesis Co, Ltd., Japan on a HiSeq 2000 (Illumina) using an Illumina V3 Kit, resulting in 20 million exome reads from each library.	Whole exome sequence reads were aligned to the mm9 reference sequence using the Burrows-Wheeler Aligner (BWA).
